summary: Baofeng UV-5RX CPS 20231124 WriFreq.CaculateCTCSS_HexToStr treats a tone word as OFF only when its low byte is 0x00 or 0xFF; a nonzero high byte means CTCSS = word/10, so it would also show 30 FF as 6532.8. Bad data in that channel, not another encoding. Web Programmer decodeTone does not throw and writes the same word back.
